prompt:
Use case: logo-brand / style-transfer.
The supplied image is Ceviche's existing app icon and a reference for its ceviche food identity. Redesign it into a coherent NEUMORPHIC CEVICHE BOWL identity system for macOS, iPhone, iPad, and web. The user specifically likes the soft sculpted / neumorphic bowl and has rejected abstract letter logos. NO C, no monogram, no abstract folded ribbon logo.

Create a polished landscape 1536 x 1024 identity presentation on a simple warm neutral canvas.

Redesign the BOWL itself:
- True overhead view: a compact CIRCULAR shallow porcelain bowl, not a tall oval. Symmetrical, optically centered.
- Very shallow delicate bowl rim with restrained soft contact shading; no heavy lip, thick ring, drop shadow or beveled pedestal. The bowl is the identity; any app tile is separate.
- A simplified, deliberate composition of three generous ivory fish pieces, two smaller coral salmon pieces, one bright green lime wedge and two short pink onion strips. Food remains clearly ceviche. No large enclosing onion crescent, no C-shaped ingredient arrangement, no star-shaped leaf or garnish. Nothing floats outside the bowl.
- Elegant tactile forms, matte soft porcelain / neumorphic depth, clean smooth surfaces. Quiet upper-left light and balanced shallow shading. Attractive and warm, not cartoon toys or a detailed food photograph. Clear broad color masses, no grain, texture, tiny veins or busy detail.
- The bowl's visible diameter is about 70% of a square app icon. Generous even space all around. The system frame never touches the bowl or doubles its rim.

Show a SAME-DESIGN SYSTEM, not unrelated variants:
1. A main identity lockup: the isolated bowl beside lowercase "ceviche" in a restrained friendly humanist sans. This is the standalone brand mark, with NO square behind the bowl.
2. Two generous app-icon previews with identical bowl composition and scale: "macOS" and "iPhone · iPad". macOS has a very restrained porcelain background and soft depth; mobile is cleaner and flatter around the bowl. The app's system rounded-square mask is only the exterior of the preview, not another painted inner tile. Avoid a pillow-like outer frame or long drop shadows.
3. A lower row: "Dark" (same bowl on deep graphite), "Tinted" (all shapes genuinely one-color sage relief), "Clear" (colorless sculpted relief), and "Small" (the same simplified bowl at small icon size). All ingredients stay in the same places in every variant.
4. A small monochrome simplified bowl emblem for web/print: a compact circular dish silhouette with just a few bold negative-space ingredient shapes. Show a positive and reversed version. It should resemble the bowl at a glance, not a random ring of dots.
5. A discreet small palette strip: porcelain, coral, lime, onion pink, graphite. No extra marketing copy.

Keep the board exceptionally clean, spaced and legible, no devices, no fake stationery, no decorative patterns, no room scenes. Prioritize the warm tactile bowl and convincing consistency across the platform previews. Opaque image.
